title: Rick Reacts to Lightning (Again) and brings up a previously undiscussed flaw
summary: Rick Falkvinge responds to viewer feedback on his earlier Lightning Network video and raises a flaw he says was not previously discussed. The main thread is the network's unsolved routing problem.
why: HN commenters cite it, with a pointer to the section from about 10:00, when arguing that Lightning has no solved routing algorithm; most mentions are critical of Lightning.

quote.text: Key bit from 10:00 on, though the rest is well worth your time
